description: Run the official Qdrant vector DB in Docker bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:6333 (REST + dashboard) and 6334 (gRPC), telemetry disabled, data in the Docker volume "qdrant". Fully offline.

steps.description: Start the Qdrant container bound to loopback (telemetry disabled), data in the Docker volume "qdrant".
steps.run: docker rm -f qdrant 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name qdrant --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:6333:6333 -p 127.0.0.1:6334:6334 -e QDRANT__TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true -v qdrant:/qdrant/storage qdrant/qdrant
for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:6333/readyz >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Qdrant still starting."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Qdrant container and its data volume.
uninstall.run: docker rm -f qdrant 2>/dev/null || true; docker volume rm qdrant 2>/dev/null || true
